steps: Buy a bucket from the Lumbridge General Store.
Buy a pot from the Lumbridge General Store.
Pick up an egg from the farm north of Lumbridge.
Pick some wheat in the field north of Lumbridge.
Climb the ladder in the mill north of Lumbridge to the top floor.
Fill the hopper with the wheat.
Operate the hopper controls.
Climb down the ladder to the ground floor.
Collect the flour from the flour bin into your pot.
Milk the dairy cow north of Lumbridge. You need a bucket.
Give the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen the three items to finish the quest. Dialogue: “What's wrong?” → “Can I help?” → “Yes”.

steps: Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador Castle. Dialogue: “And how is life as a squire?” → “I can make a new sword if you like” → “So would these dwarves make another one?” → “Yes”.
Talk to Reldo in the library of Varrock Palace. Dialogue: “What do you know about the Imcando dwarves?”.
Talk to Thurgo south of Port Sarim and give him a redberry pie. Dialogue: “Would you like a redberry pie?”.
Talk to Thurgo again. Dialogue: “Can you make a special sword for me?”.
Talk to the Squire in the courtyard of Falador Castle.
Climb up the east ladder in Falador Castle.
Go up the staircase west of the ladder on the first floor.
Search the cupboard in the room south of the staircase. Sir Vyvin must be in the other room, or he will notice you.
Bring Thurgo the portrait. Dialogue: “About that sword”.
Go down the ladder south of Port Sarim into the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. Ice giants and ice warriors attack here, so keep away from them.
Mine a blurite ore in the eastern cavern.
Return to Thurgo with a blurite ore and two iron bars. Dialogue: “Can you make that replacement sword now?”.
Return to the Squire with the sword to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to Hetty in her house in Rimmington. Dialogue: “I am in search of a quest” → “Yes”.
Kill a rat in the house to the west for a rat's tail. The tail only drops after you start the quest.
Buy an eye of newt from Betty's Magic Emporium in Port Sarim (3 gp).
Get burnt meat: kill a giant rat by the Port Sarim chapel, take its raw rat meat (raw beef works too) and cook it twice on the fireplace in Hetty's house until it burns.
Pick an onion in the field north of Rimmington.
Bring all four ingredients to Hetty.
Drink from the cauldron in Hetty's house to finish the quest.
